cases.purpose: Observe IPv4 address, netmask and interface-up state.
cases.oracle: Setup creates a new mapped user and network namespace; verifies distinct namespace identities and CAP_NET_ADMIN; creates a dummy interface and independently configures, reads and removes a native address and default route. In the same fresh namespace it seeds and checks the candidate-specific fixture, executes the frozen candidate, and retains complete stdout, stderr, status, ip JSON and /proc/net/route snapshots. Any failed namespace, dummy, native control or observation is a setup ERROR.
cases.comparison: Compare candidate status, output and independently read kernel state for addr-success. Exact ioctl requests and flags are not captured; this case cannot independently establish the full requirement.
